r0: Immediate recovery after carried food slipped while no client arrived. The portion is on the floor and the hands are empty. Next objective: pick it up on the very next move. If the agent is still empty-handed on the following step, it enters the failure sink uF. Recovering with no client returns to u0; recovering on a step when a client arrives moves to u2.
u0: Safe base/ready state with no active client order; it is also where a successful serve returns. The agent may be empty-handed or already holding raw food while waiting. Next objective: wait for the next client; if one arrives while food is held, move to u2, otherwise to u1. If carried food slips while no client arrives, recover it immediately via r0.
u1: A client is waiting and the agent is empty-handed after the arrival, with no fresh slip. The order may or may not already be taken, and no food is secured. Next objective: take the order if needed and go to the pantry. Taking the order empty-handed gives partial reward and keeps this state; picking up food moves to u2, even if the order is still untaken.
u2: A client is active and the agent has just acquired food, or has just slipped food while handling that client; the order may still need taking, and the food is not yet prepared. Next objective: if a slip just occurred, pick the food up on the very next move. Once holding raw food, take any missing order, then go to the stove and prepare. Preparing moves to u3; ending a step empty-handed without a fresh slip or preparation fails to uF.
u3: Prepared-food hand-off stage: the waiting client's order is taken and the food has been cooked; normally the agent holds it, unless it just slipped this step. Next objective: bring the prepared food to the client and serve. If it slips, stay here and pick it up on the very next move; an empty-handed step without a fresh slip or a serve fails to uF. Serving returns to u0 with the full reward.
uF: Absorbing failure state: the current client/task promise is broken, typically because a fallen portion was not recovered on the very next move, or because an active order or prepared meal was left without food and without a fresh slip or successful serve. There is no outgoing recovery or further task reward; the episode may continue, but this attempt remains failed. Contrast this with u0, the safe base and accepting state.
